Every year, millions of Californians rely on Medicare for high-quality health care & affordable prescription medication.

Repealing the Affordable Care Act would be catastrophic for our state.

In 2022, @HouseDemocrats delivered for Americans by capping insulin at $35/month for Medicare enrollees. 

As of yesterday, 3 major insulin manufacturers have followed our initiative and implemented the same price cap for privately-insured Americans.

Three years ago, @HouseDemocrats passed the American Rescue Plan and lowered health insurance costs for nearly 15 million Americans.

Today, the number of uninsured Americans is at a record low.

Today marks 14 years since the Affordable Care Act was signed into law!

The ACA has changed countless lives in the Inland Empire by lowering health care costs & getting folks insured.

Glad to join @SupervisorBaca, @CHSI_Clinics & @IEHP_healthcare to celebrate this milestone. https://t.co/b0Pg2n2Zwf

Everyone should have access to affordable health care.

I applaud @POTUS' decision to allow DACA recipients, who have known no other home than America, to enroll in Affordable Care Act marketplaces.

https://t.co/d6cCxKtEML
House Republicans are determined to repeal the Affordable Care Act, which would strip millions of Americans of the health care they need and make health insurance more expensive.

The Republican plan to gut Medicaid is going to make health care less accessible and more expensive in every community in America. 

@HouseDemocrats are going to fight back with every tool in our toolbox.

Spoke to local health care providers today about the impact of the Republican Budget slashing Medicaid. 

More than one million of our neighbors could lose their health care, and our hospitals would be devastated. 

All to pay for tax cuts for billionaires. https://t.co/G02H7OItLK

.@kcalnews Millions of Californians could lose their health care because of the Republican budget that slashes Medicaid. 

We will continue to fight back. https://t.co/aCtltpCvw3

House Republicans voted to cut Medicaid. 

The Trump Administration is dismantling the agency that ensures seniors and people with disabilities get the social security benefits they’ve earned. 

This is a betrayal of the middle class.
Here’s the truth about the Republican Budget. They are going to gut Medicaid and make health care more expensive for millions of Americans across the country. https://t.co/cIKXKj5VCh

On today’s Medicaid Day of Action, I was proud to host a press conference at SAC Health’s Mobile Clinic to spotlight how the Republican Budget’s $880 billion in Medicaid cuts will take away health care from thousands of people here in the Inland Empire. https://t.co/V59I7Mc4tE

I was proud to join local healthcare providers and patients at SAC Health’s Mobile Clinic to hear directly from them about how cuts to Medicaid would devastate their lives and the lives of their patients. https://t.co/9861jtMUYb

Republicans in Congress are pushing a budget that would force millions off their health care and make it harder for families to meet their basic needs. 

That’s why we need to force an up-or-down vote in the House to protect Medicaid and food assistance for the millions of Americans who rely on them to get by.

Republicans promised the American people that they wouldn’t cut Medicaid, but their budget throws millions off their health insurance.

They promised to lower costs on day one, but their reckless tariffs are raising prices for every American.

The only thing Republicans have delivered for the American people is broken promises.

Trump and Republicans want to throw 11 million people off their health insurance to pay for tax breaks for billionaires that explode the deficit by more than $2 trillion. 

When prices are still too high, this will only make life harder for working families.

Republicans’ Big Ugly Bill will force thousands of our neighbors in the Inland Empire off their health insurance and it will get harder for people to put food on the table. 

Proud to stand w/ ⁦@RepJeffries⁩ as he shared a local story on the House floor this morning. https://t.co/yATbjQOCdT

I just voted NO on the Republican Big Ugly Bill that kicks 17 million people off their health insurance while giving out tax breaks to billionaires. 

Republicans promised to lower costs on day one. Instead, this bill makes health care and utilities more expensive.

Last night, I was proud to host a Virtual Town Hall with my constituents where I talked about Medicaid cuts, the ongoing ICE raids and what I’m doing to fight for the Inland Empire in Congress. 

Thank you to everyone who joined me last night! If you missed it, please stay tuned for upcoming events from my office.

Cuts to Medicaid and Medi-Cal made by Trump’s One Big Ugly Law are going to hurt thousands of people with disabilities here in the Inland Empire and put the clients of organizations like Rolling Start at risk. 

I’ll keep fighting back against these reckless cuts and do everything I can to protect Medi-Cal for the people in our community who rely on it.

Republicans have launched our country into a full-blown health care crisis.

Their costly and cruel policies are gutting Medicaid and will make health insurance premiums skyrocket.

I’ll keep fighting back to bring down costs and expand access to affordable, quality health care for all Americans.

This weekend, I visited the San Bernardino Adult Day Health Care Center to see firsthand how Republican cuts to Medicaid are impacting seniors and people with disabilities in the Inland Empire. 

As a result of Republican policies to gut health care, people who rely on Adult Day Services could be forced into nursing homes or long-term care facilities, taking away their independence and dignity.

I held a press conference at the San Bernardino Adult Day Health Care Center to highlight how cuts to Medicaid in Trump’s Big Ugly Law hurt many of the people who participate in the adult day services program.

Without Medicaid, many seniors and people with disabilities here in our community may have to go without this care.

For the people who depend on adult day services at the San Bernardino Adult Day Health Care Center, Medicaid isn’t just health insurance—it’s a lifeline. 

I’ll keep fighting back against harmful Republican cuts and work to protect health care for people in the Inland Empire.  https://t.co/I08Q30TIBg
